summary: Baseline BugMgmt workflow needs definition
root_cause: Workflow expectations are not documented in project docs.
proposed_fix: Define the BugMgmt workflow and required fields in Phase 01 docs.
qa_reproduction: Review BugMgmt docs and confirm the workflow steps are not defined.
close_note: Workflow expectations are now captured in the BugMgmt Phase 01 docs and process guidelines.

summary: Document how to add new stages
root_cause: Process docs do not explain how to add stages.
proposed_fix: Add explicit stage-creation steps and examples to the process docs.
qa_reproduction: Attempt to add a stage using the docs and confirm the steps are unclear.
close_note: Stage creation steps and naming conventions are documented in the process guidelines.

summary: Details column does not display the correct details in the BugMgmt UI
root_cause: Details column only rendered optional fields and skipped the summary.
proposed_fix: Render Summary by default and only show optional fields when provided; fall back to date when opened_at is missing.
qa_reproduction: Open UI/bugmgmt_issues.html and confirm the Details column shows Summary for each issue.
close_note: UI now renders Summary and only shows detail lines when values exist; opened date falls back to date field.

summary: No per-issue detail view on click in BugMgmt UI
root_cause: UI only lists issues in a table without a dedicated detail panel.
proposed_fix: Add a detail panel that renders a selected issue when a table row is clicked.
qa_reproduction: Open UI/bugmgmt_issues.html and click an issue row; no dedicated detail view appears.
close_note: Per-issue detail panel renders on row click in BugMgmt UI.

summary: PM links column is not clickable because row click navigation intercepts anchor clicks
root_cause: The row-level click handler triggers navigation on any click within the row, including clicks on nested anchors.
proposed_fix: Ignore clicks originating from links or stop propagation on anchor clicks so link targets open as expected.
qa_reproduction: Open AI_first/ui/PM.html and click the Summary link in a project row; it navigates to the row target instead of the Summary page.
close_note: Row click handler now ignores anchor clicks so link targets open as expected.

summary: PM header action buttons overflow on narrow screens
root_cause: The header badges container does not allow wrapping, so buttons overflow when the viewport narrows.
proposed_fix: Allow flex wrapping on the badges container and adjust spacing so buttons wrap cleanly.
qa_reproduction: Open AI_first/ui/PM.html and narrow the browser; header buttons overflow or compress instead of wrapping.
close_note: Header badges now wrap to prevent overflow on narrow screens.

summary: User Docs rows show pointer cursor even though they are not clickable
root_cause: The global table row style sets cursor:pointer for all tables, even those without row navigation.
proposed_fix: Apply the pointer cursor only to rows that have data-link or a dedicated clickable class.
qa_reproduction: Hover over rows in the User Docs Hub table on AI_first/ui/PM.html; the cursor implies a click but no action occurs.
close_note: Pointer cursor and hover are limited to rows with data-link or data-id.

summary: init_project adds an extra Links column in PM.html rows when adding a project
root_cause: init_project.py _render_project_row includes a Links <td> that no longer matches the 7-column PM.html table layout.
proposed_fix: Remove the Links cell from init_project.py or have it defer to render_pm.py so PM rows match the current layout.
qa_reproduction: Run python3 AI_first/scripts/init_project.py to add a new project; PM.html renders the new row with an extra Links column not present in the header.
close_note: Removed the Links cell from the init_project PM row generator so new rows match the PM.html header.

summary: BCO1 scripts rely on ../datasets relative paths that may break after restructuring
root_cause: BCO-Demo1 hard-codes dataset paths relative to python_scripts/.
proposed_fix: Introduce a central path config (repo root + data/) and update BCO1 to use it.
qa_reproduction: Run BCO-Demo1 from a new root-based layout and observe FileNotFoundError for dataset paths.
close_note: BCO1 now resolves dataset paths from repo root and uses data/processed; dataset moved and runner updated.

summary: BCO1 entry point is not documented; multiple demo scripts exist
root_cause: Both BCO-Demo1.py and BCO-Demo2.py exist without a canonical run path documented.
proposed_fix: Confirm the BCO1 entry script and document the run command in Phase 01/02 docs.
qa_reproduction: List python_scripts and note multiple BCO demo files with no run instructions indicating the canonical entry point.
close_note: README now documents the canonical BCO1 run command (python3 scripts/run_bco1.py).

summary: Dataset duplication risk during migration and archiving
root_cause: Multiple dataset directories exist (datasets/, rust_code/datasets/) and may be copied into the new structure.
proposed_fix: Define a single canonical data location (data/) and document what moves to archive.
qa_reproduction: Compare dataset file lists across existing directories and identify duplicates before migration.
close_note: Canonical dataset location documented at data/processed; legacy datasets/ and rust_code/datasets are reference-only and slated for archive; BCO1 continues to read data/processed/updated_merged_star_exo_data.json.

summary: Data load returns (None, None, None) on failure but caller expects array
root_cause: load_custom_star_data returns a tuple of None values, yet main() assumes an ndarray and iterates it.
proposed_fix: Return None or raise, then guard in main() before sprite generation.
qa_reproduction: Point DEFAULT_DATA_FILE to a missing file and run; observe crash during sprite generation.
close_note: load_custom_star_data now returns None on failure and main() guards before sprite generation.

summary: Apparent magnitude calc can call log10(0) when distance is zero
root_cause: calculate_apparent_magnitude only guards distance < 0, not 0.
proposed_fix: Clamp distance to epsilon or guard distance <= 0 before log10.
qa_reproduction: Set observer position equal to a star position so distance is 0; observe math domain error.
close_note: calculate_apparent_magnitude now clamps distance to epsilon before log10.

summary: Star gradient mid-band branch is unreachable due to duplicate condition
root_cause: draw_star_surfaces checks i < RADIUS // 2 twice, making the mid-gradient never run.
proposed_fix: Fix the conditional to use RADIUS // 4 for the middle band.
qa_reproduction: Inspect star surface generation; mid gradient never used.
close_note: Gradient bands now use RADIUS // 4 for the inner threshold, restoring the mid-band blend.

summary: create_circle_surfaces passes float sizes into pygame.transform.smoothscale
root_cause: radius/2 produces floats for surface sizes.
proposed_fix: Cast to int and ensure minimum size >= 1.
qa_reproduction: Run with strict pygame type checks; smoothscale may raise or clip.
close_note: Circle surface scaling now uses integer sizes with a minimum of 1px.

summary: Star type index can be out of range for canvas_set
root_cause: canvas_set only contains 7 star types; data may contain other values.
proposed_fix: Clamp or map unknown star types to a default surface.
qa_reproduction: Load a dataset with a star type value outside 0-6; observe IndexError.
close_note: Star type index is clamped to valid range when building sprites.

summary: should_draw_star contains unreachable code after early returns
root_cause: Function returns before sigmoid block.
proposed_fix: Remove dead code or rework logic to use the probability branch.
qa_reproduction: Inspect should_draw_star; lines after return never execute.
close_note: Removed unreachable sigmoid block and simplified return flow.

summary: blit_labels references undefined scale_labels
root_cause: Function returns a variable that is never defined.
proposed_fix: Fix return signature or remove the unused function.
qa_reproduction: Call blit_labels; NameError for scale_labels.
close_note: Removed the unused blit_labels stub that referenced undefined scale_labels.

summary: Filter selection is hover-based, causing accidental changes
root_cause: draw_futuristic_menu returns selection on hover without click handling.
proposed_fix: Switch to click-to-select and show active state.
qa_reproduction: Move mouse across menu; filter changes without clicking.
close_note: Menu now selects filters on click and renders the active selection state.

summary: Arrow buttons do not show hover state or respond to clicks
root_cause: Hover state is never computed and click handler is unused.
proposed_fix: Compute hover and wire click events to parsec changes.
qa_reproduction: Hover and click arrow buttons; no feedback or action.
close_note: Arrow buttons now show hover state and respond to click changes.

summary: Slider UI is commented out, removing on-screen zoom control
root_cause: handle_slider and slider interaction are disabled in main loop.
proposed_fix: Re-enable slider drawing and interaction or remove dead code.
qa_reproduction: Run the app; no slider appears despite slider logic present.
close_note: Slider drawing and interaction are re-enabled for zoom control.

summary: No persistent UI state for active filter selection
root_cause: Menu only returns transient hover index; selection is not stored.
proposed_fix: Store selected filter in app state and render active style.
qa_reproduction: Move mouse off menu; selection reverts or becomes undefined.
close_note: Filter selection is stored in control state and rendered as active.

summary: No visual highlight for selected star
root_cause: Selection only toggles info visibility without visual star highlight.
proposed_fix: Add highlight ring or outline for selected star.
qa_reproduction: Click a star; info panel appears but star is not highlighted.
close_note: Selected stars now render a highlight ring when info is visible.

summary: Per-frame text rendering allocates new surfaces each frame
root_cause: writeText creates new font surfaces inside the render loop.
proposed_fix: Cache text surfaces and update only when content changes.
qa_reproduction: Profile render loop; font rendering dominates frame time.
close_note: Static text is pre-rendered and dynamic text surfaces update only when content changes; fonts are cached.

summary: find_star_by_position runs every frame due to default mouse coords
root_cause: mouse_x/mouse_y default to -1 so condition always true, scanning all stars.
proposed_fix: Track actual click events and only run hit-test on click.
qa_reproduction: Profile loop; hit-testing runs every frame without interaction.
close_note: Star hit-testing now runs only on unconsumed left-click events; default mouse coords are None.

summary: Info panels are recreated and scaled every frame
root_cause: drawInfo calls create_info_surface and scales each frame.
proposed_fix: Cache info surfaces and only update on selection or scale change.
qa_reproduction: Enable info panels and profile; surface creation dominates frame time.
close_note: Info surfaces are created once per star and scaled only when the scale factor changes.

summary: update_visibility prints per match, spamming logs
root_cause: Debug prints left in the hot loop for exoplanet filter.
proposed_fix: Remove prints or gate behind a debug flag.
qa_reproduction: Select exoplanet filter; console floods with messages.
close_note: Removed debug prints from update_visibility hot path.

summary: Data prep uses df.iterrows for coordinate transforms
root_cause: load_custom_star_data loops row-by-row for coordinate conversion.
proposed_fix: Vectorize coordinate transforms or use NumPy operations.
qa_reproduction: Load dataset; conversion step is slow on large files.
close_note: Vectorized galactic→equatorial and Cartesian transforms to avoid per-row iterrows loop.

summary: Visibility filtering scans all sprites on each radius/filter change
root_cause: update_visibility loops every sprite and recomputes distance each time.
proposed_fix: Precompute per-star distance metrics and filter masks; build visible indices with vectorized comparisons.
qa_reproduction: Profile a parsec or filter change on a large dataset; update_visibility dominates.
close_note: Precomputed distance-squared and filter masks, and visibility now uses vectorized mask + index add.

summary: Rotation updates compute all star positions even when most are hidden
root_cause: rotate_points_numba is called on the full star array regardless of visibility.
proposed_fix: Rotate only the currently visible indices (or prefiltered subset) and update those sprites.
qa_reproduction: Enable a tight radius filter and rotate; CPU usage stays high as if all stars are processed.
close_note: Rotation now runs only on visible indices and updates visible sprites only.

summary: Per-star update recomputes variant, magnitude, and rect every position update
root_cause: update_2d_position randomizes twinkle, recalculates magnitude, and allocates a new rect each update.
proposed_fix: Throttle twinkle updates, reuse rects by updating center, and only recompute magnitude when observer distance changes.
qa_reproduction: Profile rotation; update_2d_position dominates per-frame time.
close_note: Twinkle updates are throttled, rects are reused when possible, and magnitude updates only when observer position changes.

summary: Magnitude index is computed per star in Python for each visible update
root_cause: calculate_apparent_magnitude + get_index_from_magnitude are called for each star in Python.
proposed_fix: Vectorize magnitude/index calculation for visible stars or move to a Numba batch path.
qa_reproduction: Profile rotation with many visible stars; magnitude/index computation shows significant time.
close_note: Magnitude indices now compute in a vectorized batch for visible stars and are reused across rotations.

summary: Distance calculation recomputes full norm per star instead of using cached values
root_cause: calculate_distance computes sqrt for every star using full vector difference.
proposed_fix: Precompute per-star squared distances and update only the observer-axis term per frame.
qa_reproduction: Profile rotations while changing observer distance; distance calc appears in the hot path.
close_note: Magnitude distance uses cached XY^2 and Z values, updating only the observer-axis term.

summary: Sun toggle UI does not hide the Sun sprite
root_cause: Toggle flips show_sun but the Sun remains in the visible sprite group so it is still drawn; a second draw_sun flag is unused, making debugging misleading.
proposed_fix: When building custom_visible_star_sprites skip or remove the Sun and only blit it when show_sun is true; remove or consolidate the unused draw_sun toggle to a single flag.
qa_reproduction: Run scripts/run_bco1.py; click the Show Sun toggle or press S to turn it off; Sun still renders because it is drawn via custom_visible_star_sprites.draw regardless of the show_sun flag.
close_note: Sun toggling now forces a visibility refresh and removes/adds the Sun sprite to the draw group in-line with show_sun; redundant draw_sun hotkey removed.
